Subject: MAP: Load replay booking + capacity checklist for OmniRetail POC

Hi Alex / Sasha —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed MAP milestones focused on the performance validation step (as discussed):

Milestone: Traffic replay run (dry-run + peak QPS)
- Target window: week of Mar 22 (dry run) and Mar 24 (peak QPS) — tentative, subject to ops availability.
- Responsibility: OmniRetail to provide traffic sample + top-50 user journeys; Redwood to provision replay infra and run with ops on-call.
- Dependency: final traffic sample + list of endpoints by Mar 18.

Milestone: Dedicated capacity sizing confirmation
- Deliverable: Redwood to propose GPU pool config and expected throughput. Owner: Marissa (in RDW).
- Target close date for sizing decision: Mar 25.

Milestone: Post-test performance report & next-step recommendation
- Redwood to deliver a short report (latency percentiles, error rates, cost estimate) within 3 business days after peak run.

Next steps I suggest this week:
1) Alex: upload the sanitized traffic sample and the list of endpoints to the Drive link shared below by EOD Thu (Mar 18).
2) Marissa: share a draft dedicated capacity recommendation (GPU types / instance counts / estimated cost) by Fri (Mar 19).
3) Priyom: Ops runbook for the replay — quick checklist (who's on call, signal URLs) — ready for review by Mar 19.

I've attached a MAP_v1.xlsx with the milestones mapped to owners and dates. Note that the replay dry-run should be run at 60% of observed peak first, then scaled to 100% for the peak QPS window.

If these windows look tight, tell me what slack you need and we'll push accordingly — we want to avoid impacting production traffic.

Thanks,
Rishi
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com

Thanks Rishi — this looks good. Quick clarifications: 

- We can get you a sanitized traffic sample by Thu EOD (Mar 18). Will include top endpoints and a mapping of user journeys. I'll anonymize PII and drop anything not needed.
- For the dry-run we'd prefer a morning window (US Pacific) on Mar 22 — low traffic period for us. Peak QPS window we can reserve Mar 24 11:00-12:30 PT. Can you confirm Redwood ops can support those times?
- One dependency: our infra team needs to white-list Redwood's replay IPs and we need a short security attestation. Sasha, can you coordinate with infra?

Alex / Rishi —

Thanks for the timeline. A few operational notes on capacity sizing and what I'll deliver:

- Proposal: For the initial replay (mix of short chat-like requests + longer completion calls) I recommend a mixed pool: 4 x A100-80GB (quantized model variant) + 2 x A100-40GB for cache-heavy workloads. This should comfortably handle an observed peak ~275 QPS with room for a 20% headroom.
- If we need lower-cost testing, we can run the dry-run on 2 x A40-style instances and accept slightly higher latency; I'll put both options in the doc.
- I'll include expected token throughput, estimated per-hour cost, and a rollback plan (auto-scale down if error rate >1%).
- Deliverable ETA: Fri Mar 19 EOD.

Priyom / Vivek — please confirm ops availability for Mar 22 morning and Mar 24 11:00-12:30 PT. Priyom, can you draft the runbook checklist (on-call contact, replay IPs, monitoring dashboards) and drop it into the Drive folder?
